about: Inputs made by Python 3.15.0 lzma module (liblzma) (liblzma decodes each back to its payload). cases: decoded length and SHA-256 of the payload, byte exact. errors: the TypeError message for each damaged input.

errors.name: too short (9 bytes)
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (too short)

errors.name: props byte 225
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (bad properties)

errors.name: range coder first byte not 0
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (range coder start byte)

errors.name: truncated alone stream (half)
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (unexpected end)

errors.name: alone without its last byte
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (unexpected end)

errors.name: known size larger than the data
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (end marker before the unpacked size)

errors.name: known size smaller than the data
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (match past the unpacked size)

errors.name: xz bad magic (not XZ, so read as .lzma)
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (bad properties)

errors.name: xz truncated
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (chunk past the end)

errors.name: xz with delta filter before LZMA2
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (XZ filter 3 (only LZMA2 alone is read))

errors.name: xz with x86 BCJ filter
errors.message: Invalid JT file: corrupt LZMA data (XZ filter 4 (only LZMA2 alone is read))
